moretraffic.ponder.cabinet_1.text_1: Can be used to make complex systems and automations that control other MoreTraffic blocks
moretraffic.ponder.cabinet_1.text_2: It has 2 main categories: Groups and Instructions
moretraffic.ponder.cabinet_1.text_3: Groups allow you to group different MoreTraffic Blocks and modify them together
moretraffic.ponder.cabinet_1.text_4: You can modify them with instructions
moretraffic.ponder.cabinet_1.text_5: Open the GUI and explore! View tips in GUI by hovering on info icons
moretraffic.ponder.cabinet_2.text_1: The Control Cabinet can react to Create train signals
moretraffic.ponder.cabinet_2.text_2: First, right-click the Cabinet while holding a Display Link
moretraffic.ponder.cabinet_2.text_3: Then place it on a Train Signal
moretraffic.ponder.cabinet_2.text_4: In the Display Link menu, select 'Signal Occupancy' and confirm
moretraffic.ponder.cabinet_2.text_5: Add 'Await train signal on' and 'off' instructions between your light changes, then run them in a loop
moretraffic.ponder.cabinet_2.text_6: 'Await train signal on' continues once a train turns the signal red
moretraffic.ponder.cabinet_2.text_7: 'Await train signal off' continues once the signal is no longer red
block.moretraffic.crossing_barrier.toolt: Barrier for _level crossings_, controlled by the Control Cabinet.
_Lowers_ on an enabled pulse and _raises_ on a disabled one.
block.moretraffic.derailer.tooltip.summa: Can _derail trains_ and prevent them from riding through gates, etc...
block.moretraffic.derailer.tooltip.condi: While Redstone-powered or pulsed with Control Cabinet
block.moretraffic.derailer.tooltip.behav: _Derails any train_ that passes over derailer.
block.moretraffic.girded_truss.tooltip.s: _Spice up_ your builds or constructions with this _heavy duty truss_!
Adds _railing and walkway_. Remove with wrench.
block.moretraffic.signboard.tooltip.summ: Signboard can display _custom text and background_ with support for customization.
block.moretraffic.signboard.tooltip.beha: _Copies_ the data of the Signboard, by _left clicking the clipboard_ on another Signboard
block.moretraffic.traffic_pillar.tooltip: _Thicker version_ for the Traffic Craft's Traffic sign post!
_Changes_ the truss pillar's facing in some modes!

gui.moretraffic.advanced_traffic_light.o:
Choose a static color for this light, or click black to turn it off.
Keep in mind that using control cabinet may override this color.
Using masking, shapes or pictograms (turning arrows, pedestrian icon, etc.) can be displayed on lights. Unlike in trafficcraft, masks can be unique for each light.
Start by drawing your mask, or use the buttons on the right to import or export

Left mouse button: click and hold to add pixels,
Right mouse button: click and hold to delete pixels
Load a mask from your clipboard
Copy the mask data to your clipboard. This is a string of numbers, so you can paste it outside of the game too
Turn an 16x16 image into a mask
For best results, use a 16x16 image with transparent and filled pixels. May not work perfectly.

gui.moretraffic.control_cabinet.instruct:
No instructions are here!
Add instructions or configure groups below.
Executes next action after a set amount of seconds (can be a decimal)
Pauses execution until the block receives a redstone signal
Pauses execution until a linked train signal is red. Link one with a Display Link placed on a Train Signal
Pauses execution until no linked train signal is red. Link one with a Display Link placed on a Train Signal
Works with Advanced Traffic Lights and LED strips
Works with Level Crossing Barriers, Blinkers and Derailers
The program finished. Enable repeat to run it in a loop
gui.moretraffic.control_cabinet.instruct: Modifies MoreTraffic lights that were added to the respective group
Modifies MoreTraffic displays that were added to the respective group with an editable image
Load pixel data from your clipboard
Copy pixel data to your clipboard. This is a string of letters, so you can paste it outside of the game too
Toggles redstone for positions in the group. Only works for some MoreTraffic blocks.

gui.moretraffic.control_cabinet.groups.m: Groups allow you to group lights (and other things) from this mod to different groups and then modify them with instructions.
gui.moretraffic.control_cabinet.groups.c:
The easiest way is a Group Controller: add blocks with it, then right-click this cabinet. You can also create a group here and add positions by hand (/copypos copies coordinates).
Then, you can modify blocks in this group using instructions and targeting this group.
